name: Theraplo
author: Theraplo

sections.description:
Theraplo seamlessly integrates appointment booking functionality into WordPress websites for therapy practices and healthcare professionals. The plugin provides multiple ways to embed interactive booking calendars on your site.

Key Features

  • Multiple Integration Methods: Shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks, WordPress widgets, and Elementor widgets
  • Specialist-Specific Calendars: Individual booking calendars for each practitioner
  • Service and Location Filtering: Pre-filter appointments by service type and location
  • Responsive Design: Mobile-friendly with customizable styling
  • Admin Interface: Easy configuration and management
  • Flexible Customization: Add custom CSS to match your brand

Integration Options

Shortcodes:
* [theraplo-full] – Full calendar view
* [theraplo-user data-id="specialist-id"] – User-specific calendar

Gutenberg Block:
* Theraplo Calendar block with visual editor controls

WordPress Widget:
* Available in Appearance > Widgets

Elementor Widget:
* Available in Elementor page builder

Who Is This For?

  • Therapy practices
  • Healthcare professionals
  • Wellness centers
  • Individual therapists
  • Medical clinics
  • Any appointment-based business
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin
  2. Search for “Theraplo”
  3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  4. You’ll see a welcome notice – click “Complete setup”
  5. Add your Theraplo configuration and start using widgets!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Go to Theraplo > Setup to configure

Quick Start

After activation, you’ll see:
– Welcome notice with setup link
– “Settings” link on plugins page
– New “Theraplo” menu in WordPress admin

For Elementor Users

  • Install and activate Elementor
  • Look for “Theraplo Calendar” widget in Elementor’s widget panel
  • Drag and drop to use!

Need Help?

Visit the Introduction page (Theraplo > Introduction) for complete documentation and examples.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Theraplo account?

Yes, you need a Theraplo account and configuration to use this plugin. Visit the plugin setup page after installation to configure your account settings.

Can I customize the calendar appearance?

Yes, you can add custom CSS in the Theraplo > Advanced settings page to style the calendar according to your needs.

Is this compatible with my theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme. The calendars are responsive and will adapt to your theme’s styling.
